description: NaPNH₃O₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PNO₃ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.44 Å. P is bonded to one N and three equivalent O atoms to form PNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-54°. The P-N bond length is 1.81 Å. All P-O bond lengths are 1.53 Å. N is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one P and three equivalent H atoms. All N-H bond lengths are 1.05 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom.
